7.0.0.rawDesc:
Fishermen carry their catches from ship to barrow.  The strong cleansing
smell of the sea engulfs all who come near.  Many different boats enter the
port while many others leave.  A few business owners have set up a few shops
here to take advantage of the incoming sailors and tourists.  A large sign
full of information is attracting some attention.

8.0.0.rawDesc:
You see the vast open sea to the west.  Seagulls fly all about and waves
slowly invade the sand.  A port stands to the west where large and small
boats alike enter and leave.  To the east you see a forest.

9.0.0.rawName: A Trail from Roully Bab Binb to Arkane
9.0.0.rawDesc:
You stand on a trail amid a small, green forest.  You can hear the sounds
of woodland creatures and a warm, salty breeze from the west rustling
through the trees and your hair.  Far to the east, you think you can see a
city and to the west, the ocean of Roully Bab Binb lines the horizon.

10.0.0.rawDesc:
Far to the east you can see the gates of the mighty city of Arkane.  To
the west you can still smell the sea breeze.  The forest has dwindled down
into a field that appears to be man made.  Perhaps the trees that once stood
here are what built Arkane.  To the North lie the ruins of the Pirate's
Hideout.  There is nothing left but a pile of rubble.

11.0.0.rawName: A Field in the Middle of a Forest
11.0.0.rawDesc:
You stand in the middle of a field that seems to be surrounded by forest
on both sides.  The salt air of the sea is beginning to diminish here and
the sound of what appears to be children giggling reaches you from the edges
of the forest.  To the north lies a huge crater.  To the south lies a very
large tree, but roots and branches to the tree make the journey almost
impossible.

12.0.0.rawDesc:
From the middle of the field, you can just make out the tips of the sails
in the port to the west, but Arkane's city gates are looming to the east. 
Perpetual giggling invades the would-be silence, apparently coming from the
forests to the north and south.  The trees all around you seem young and
fresh, fragile as the breeze sends another wave of leaves down at the edges
of the field.  A battlefield can be seen to the northwest.  A path upwards
leads to The Academy.

21.-6.0.rawDesc:
You see the gates of Arkane to the south.  To the north is a dirt trail
leading into a forest.  A dark church has been built off the path to the
west.

20.-6.0.rawDesc:
Unfolding before you is a vast passage of the purest onyx, styled and crafted
into smooth, unmarred walls.  A natural glow radiates from its surface from
illumination further away.  The passage spans a great, uncountable height and
length, and the polished surface lends even more to that illusion.  The cool,
dark interior echos noises that sound off randomly, as they envelope the passage,
then dissipate.

19.-6.0.rawDesc:
The altar room stands wide and tall, with great expanses made for
gathering.  Deep black obsidian covers the ceiling, floor, and walls, cut
and polished to a tedious perfection.  It contrasts slightly in the joining
of onyx and jet, creating a small swirl of chaos along the room's edges, yet
the different stones seem to lock into each other perfectly.  Dark sconces
adorn the wall about the altar room, their firelight bounding shadows and
glints of light off the polished obsidian surfaces.  A large sacrificial
altar stands in middle-front of the room, as the obsidian floor rises
fluidly towards it.  The altar itself is carved from the same obsidian, and
is seemingly a part of the rising dias.  A carved hole within the altar
itself shows its purpose as sacrificial in nature, while the ornate carvings
about the construction calls forth all powers of Necrucifer's lineage alike.

19.-5.0.rawDesc:
Only a very few sconces light this chamber, leaving a dim hue of orange
lazily bounding from the pure jet stone of the walls, ceiling, and floor. 
The chamber should rightly be cool and full of echoes, however, it instead
radiates a comfortable warmth, and is mysterious quiet.  The general lull of
this room is somewhat soothing.  Slabs of jet extend from the walls, and
seem to be used for resting or sleeping.  From the floor in the middle of
the room extends a jet fountain, brushed with silver.  It bubbles quietly,
almost unheard.

21.-7.0.rawDesc:
From all around you hear the giggling on hidden kender.  The forest here
is very green and full of wildlife.  The trail continues north.  A path
upwards leads to The Academy.

21.-8.0.rawDesc:
Up above you notice that the trees are extremely tall and funny shaped. 
It's almost as though the trees were shaped by magic.  At the very top, you
can see a birds nest.  It looks like it must be a rather large bird.  There
is something carved into one of the trees.  Colorful flowers can be seen
through the trees to the west.

21.-9.0.rawDesc:
[0;37mWarm, oozing mud streaks the terrain, imbedding itself into every nook
and hole as the [1;30mg[0;37mra[1;37my[0;37mis[1;30mh [0;35mpurple[0;37m mass rolls to and fro, claiming loose dirt,
pebbles and other matter as its own as it slides along to cover all in its
path.  It's depth is hard to determine and those daring to trudge across
find that their footsteps are squelched by the sticky, thick sludge even
before they begin to form.  [0m


[0;33mSeveral slightly warped and different length logs have been tossed over the
mass of muck, bark still covering the top of the logs while the underside of
each, seems to have been cleanly stripped from the wood.  Knots and some
tiny branches stick out over the edge and thick rope binds them all
together.  While it is serviceable, it does not seem to be overly sturdy... 
[0m

21.-10.0.rawDesc:
Despite how dense the forest is here, blocking any travel to the east or
west, the north/south trail seems quite well established.  This path must be
one travelled regularly by many.

21.-11.0.rawDesc:
[0;37mThis well-travelled trail through the forest continues to the north and
south.  The depth and darkness of the forest are pervasive here, perhaps
something other than just the forces of nature are keeping things dark here.
 
[0;37mJust off the path, many fresh [0;33mcut logs[0;37m have been piled with the scent of
wood filling the air.  Nearby, a raft trader and his apprentice work his
craft with several axes leaning against a grindstone for sharpening while
others stand ready to chop lumber to the sizing he needs.  His finished
products are neatly stacked near the trail for those wishing to make a
purchase.[0m

21.-12.0.rawDesc:
The path continues through the forest here.  Although you can see the
path continuing north and south from here, your views to the east and west
are limited by the presence of extremely dense trees and brush.  This must
be a very well-travelled trail, otherwise the brush would surely have
overtaken the path.

21.-13.0.rawName: End of a Trail Through the Forest
21.-13.0.rawDesc:
The trail seems to end here and you notice that you are surrounded by
forest on three sides.  Despite how well traveled the path seems to the
south of you, there doesn't seem to be any way to get here from any other
direction.  Looking more closely at the dense forest around you, you notice
something unusual about the brush to the east.  The brush to the north has
been cleared away, and a large gray stone church can be seen through the
trees.

21.-14.0.rawName: Entrance to the Temple of the Gray Order
21.-14.0.rawDesc:
You stand in the entrance to the Temple of the Gray Order, a refuge for
those who are weary in body and spirit.  Built by the Order to help all the
people of Algoron, this stone Temple conveys a sense of peace.  Delicate
stone and iron lattice work provides curving frames for colorful stained
glass windows depicting religious stories of all the pantheon of Algoron.

21.-15.0.rawDesc:
The altar room in the Temple of the Gray Order is dedicated to all the
gods and goddesses of Algoron.  Welcoming to all, an unassuming altar stands
awaiting the prayers of any who wish, to whomever they wish to pray.

22.-15.0.rawDesc:
This room is cast with warm golden and red hues from the windows.  You
seem to feel healthier and stronger each moment you remain.  Pillows,
blankets and rugs have been placed about the room for weary visitors to rest
and meditate on.

22.-13.0.rawName: Hidden Trail Through a Thick Forest
22.-13.0.rawDesc:
You have stumbled onto a hidden trail in the thick undergrowth of a
forest.  The trail appears to have been deliberately made to be overlooked
easily.  Looking to the north, the forest is quite thick and in deep shadow
making it hard to see more than a few yards in any one direction.  To the
Northeast you see the ruins of the Gypsy wagons.  There is nothing left but
some charred remains.

22.-14.0.rawName: Hidden Trail Through a Thick Forest
22.-14.0.rawDesc:
The forest struggles to close quietly around this trail in shadow, and
under ordinary circumstances there would be barely enough light to find the
way.  The trail, though well hidden, is well taken care of as it cuts a path
through the dense forest.  


High overhead the lucent threads of an [1;33mAurora[0m shine a harsh and blinding
light down upon the forest below.  The once shadowy embrace of the canopy is
pierced by scouring rays that illuminate even the darkest recesses of the
dense wood.  What first appears to be a trick of the light, becomes clear
that the brush, trees, and ancient trees themselves have been turned subtle
shades of [1;37mpristine alabaster, [0m transformed by the aurora and [1;37mpillars[0m which
moor it.  [0m

29.0.-1.rawDesc:
Deep ruts mar the ground, created by carts pulled up the muddy hill to
supply Arkane with the needed goods to support it's population.  Some of the
ruts are very wide and filled with water and muck.  


Up the muddy hill to the west is the kingdom of Arkane, while off to the
east is the Great Forest and the Crystal Fields can be seen in the distance.

30.0.-1.rawDesc:
[0;37mWarm, oozing mud streaks the terrain, imbedding itself into every nook
and hole as the [1;30mg[0;37mra[1;37my[0;37mis[1;30mh [0;35mpurple[0;37m mass rolls to and fro, claiming loose dirt,
pebbles and other matter as its own as it slides along to cover all in its
path.  It's depth is hard to determine and those daring to trudge across
find that their footsteps are squelched by the sticky, thick sludge even
before they begin to form.  [0m


[0;33mSeveral slightly warped and different length logs have been tossed over the
mass of muck, bark still covering the top of the logs while the underside of
each, seems to have been cleanly stripped from the wood.  Knots and some
tiny branches stick out over the edge and thick rope binds them all
together.  While it is serviceable, it does not seem to be overly sturdy... 
[0m

31.0.-1.rawDesc:
To the west is the "Great mudslide" as it is known throughout Algoron,
the trade route to the west gate of Arkane.  To the east lie the Crystal
fields.  The ground here is somewhat muddy with small ruts creating a swath
of crisscrossing lines.

32.0.-1.rawDesc:
To the west of you, the frontier town of Arkane can be seen.  While, off
to the north, far in the distance, you can see a vast mountain range, with
peaks that seem to be snowcapped year round.  To the northwest, the Great
Forest can be seen.  To the Southeast, a small village can be seen.

33.0.-1.rawDesc:
The road you are on continues off interminably to the east, while back to
the west Arkane's chapel can be seen glimmering in the light.  Huge trees,
and lots of them, line the horizon to the northwest, their gentle leaves
swaying in the light breeze.

34.0.-1.rawDesc:
Leaves drift by on the wind from the trees to the north.  You're sure the
entrance to the Forest is around here somewhere.  Smells from the kitchen's
in Arkane are apparent as you glance back towards the town, to the west. 
The road you are on continues off to the east, losing itself on the horizon.

35.0.-1.rawDesc:
The mighty trees of the Great Forest rise before you to the north, their
massive trunks twisting towards the sky in savage grace.  To the west, the
sounds and smells of Arkane are barely present, while off to the east, the
road continues indiscernably.

36.0.-1.rawDesc:
The road you are traveling on, continues off to the east into the
horizon.  Trees line your vision to the north and the sounds of a river can
be heard in the distance.  The flash of white stone can be seen through the
trees to the north.

37.0.-1.rawDesc:
The road opens up past the temple into a large route.  Horse drawn wagons
haul supplies to the different cities for trade.  That however is the only
lingering evidence of nearby city life.  The bulk of the travelers are
composed of gypsies and vagrants.  Along the northern horizon you can only
make out the tallest of treetops from the Great Forest.

44.1.-1.rawDesc:
The Arkania Highroad takes a winding course along the rim of the Pillar of
[1;31mFire[0m Canyon.  The Canyon is the location of phoenix nesting grounds.  A
large column of fire can be seen endlessly burning and filling the air with
falling ash.

45.1.-1.rawDesc:
The Arkania Highroad skirts along the rim of the Pillar of [1;31mFire[0m Canyon. 
Ash falls all around you and you smell the strong odor of sulfur.  High
overhead you see a smoke trail from a burning phoenix.

46.0.-1.rawDesc:
The Arkania Highroad skirts along the rim of the Pillar of [1;31mFire[0m Canyon. 
Ash falls all around you and you smell the strong odor of sulfur.  High
overhead you see a smoke trail from a burning phoenix.

47.-1.-1.rawDesc:
On either side of the Highroad you can see dotted along the hillsides
sulfur mines.  The odor is almost overwhelming when the wind doesn't carry
it away.  Just west from the mines you can see a large Canyon with a massive
flame spewing forth.

48.-1.-1.rawDesc:
Along the Highroad here you can see approaching to the west a collection
of sulfur mines.  To the southern horizon you see a beautiful set of
rainbows.  Though when you turn north you can see a small swamp land area. 
The Highroad forks here.

49.-1.-1.rawDesc:
North of the road the swamp lands appear to give way to a long stretch of
plains.  Large oak trees line either side of the Highroad here nearly
closing out the view of the sky above as their large low branches meet above
your head.

50.-1.-1.rawDesc:
North of the road is a vast beautiful plain, home to a few wandering
leonine and wild elven tribes.  The Highroad has been paved along the side
of a growing hill that blocks the view southward.

51.-1.-1.rawDesc:
You have arrived at the Floating Archway.  It makes a good landmark for
the Highroad.  The archway is a stone formation of boulders that hover
precariously above your head.  The several tons of rock even move an inch
or two in any direction.

52.-1.-1.rawDesc:
The landscape flows in from a vast northern plains to the Highroad above
on steps of an equally impressive plateau.  Dotting the land below are ponds
and a small creek making for a relaxing expanse of terrain.

53.-1.-1.rawDesc:
The elevation of the Highroad raises yet again as it climbs a steep
plateau.  A few lonely trees are up here but it's mostly open space.  A herd
trail leads from the plateau to the plains and grasslands to the north.

53.0.-1.rawDesc:
To the side of the Highroad on the plateau is nestled a large watering
hole.  It might be a good idea for travelers to rest here if they've still a
long way to go.  A few silk trees line the far shoreline of the large pond.

53.1.-1.rawName: At the Base of Windmill Butte
53.1.-1.rawDesc:
The Highroad passes around the base of Windmill Butte.  The Windmill has
long been abandoned but still spins in the occassional gust.  The colors of
a long forgotten kingdom flag, flay faded and worn, high above the mill.

54.2.-1.rawDesc:
A plateau rises up from the savanna to the south here.  The road forks to
the north up the plateau and to the southwest, leading to a peaceful trail
along the cliff side.  A few animal herds are the only other scenery on this
stretch of the Highroad.

53.3.-1.rawDesc:
The road cuts through and over a series of peaceful rolling hills.  From
here you can see a large savanna to the south and to the north is a large
cliff face of a plateau.  The South Highroad merges with the main Highroad
just to the northeast.

54.3.-1.rawDesc:
The road here changes levels.  To the north it climbs up hills leading
towards a large plateau, and to the south it cuts through a vast savanna. 
You can see the road curving back to the east as it follows a large river.

55.3.-1.rawDesc:
The Lowroad twist lazily along a wide river to the south as you travel
through the savanna.  The sounds of wildlife can be heard all around you. 
Otters swim in the river in search of shellfish.

56.3.-1.rawDesc:
The Lowroad cuts through the tall grass of the savanna.  Creatively
strung up along the road are firefly powered lanterns.  Tiny bowls inside
the lanterns hold some sugar water and appear to be well maintained.

57.3.-1.rawDesc:
The Lowroad cuts through the tall grass of the savanna.  Creatively
strung up along the road are firefly powered lanterns.  Tiny bowls inside
the lanterns hold some sugar water and appear to be well maintained.

58.3.-1.rawDesc:
Along the side of the Lowroad here bubbles a tar pit.  Post and ropes
have been set up to partially baracade any travelers from accidently falling
off the road and into the sticky hot tar.  From time to time a large bubble
will burst and send tar flying onto the road.

59.3.-1.rawDesc:
The Lowroad cuts through the tall grass of the savanna.  Creatively
strung up along the road are firefly powered lanterns.  Tiny bowls inside
the lanterns hold some sugar water and appear to be well maintained.

62.3.-1.rawDesc:
The Lowroad cuts through the tall grass of the savanna.  Creatively
strung up along the road are firefly powered lanterns.  Tiny bowls inside
the lanterns hold some sugar water and appear to be well maintained.

63.3.-1.rawDesc:
The Arkane Lowroad runs between two narrow cliffs that mark the west
entrance to Arth-ethile Valley.  A grove of banana trees have grown in the
wilderness here, along with a few berry plants and shrubs along the road.

64.2.-1.rawDesc:
Deep inbetween two cliffs you travel along the Arkanian Lowroad.  The
forces of nature are strong here and the dense wilderness of the Valley has
begun to grow onto the road in several places.

65.1.-1.rawDesc:
Deep inbetween two cliffs you travel along the Arkanian Lowroad.  The
forces of nature are strong here and the dense wilderness of the Valley has
begun to grow onto the road in several places.

66.0.-1.rawDesc:
Deep inbetween two cliffs you travel along the Arkanian Lowroad.  The
forces of nature are strong here and the dense wilderness of the Valley has

67.-1.-1.rawDesc:
You can see a large fenced plantation to the north.  Bananas and spices
can be seen being harvested by busy workers.  Other than the plantation the
road continues through the Valley.

68.-1.-1.rawDesc:
Deep inbetween two cliffs you travel along the Arkanian Lowroad.  The
forces of nature are strong here and the dense wilderness of the Valley has
begun to grow onto the road in several places.

69.-1.-1.rawDesc:
You have arrived at the eastern entrance of Arth-ethile Valley.  A few
banana trees grow near the road.  Just to the east the valley gives way to a
large dusty basin.  To the west a dense jungle grows within the valley.

70.-1.-1.rawDesc:
You travel along the Lowroad across a flat near barren basin.  A few fig
trees along the roadside are the only source of food within sight.  Looking
east you can see some tall mountain peek on the horizon, and to the west you
see a valley approaching.

71.-1.-1.rawDesc:
You are at the western entrance to the Arkania Tunnel.  The air in the
tunnel is damp and cold.  Enchanted stones glow with light as they sense you
move near, and then dim and go out as you pass.

71.0.-1.rawDesc:
Deep inside the Arkania Tunnel Road you travel underneath the Gryphon
Mountains.  The road is lonely and the enchanting lights offer little
comfort from the damp air.  It's absolutely miserable and depressing here.

72.1.-1.rawDesc:
Deep inside the Arkania Tunnel Road you travel underneath the Gryphon
Mountains.  The road is lonely and the enchanting lights offer little

75.1.-1.rawDesc:
A series of abandon rail carts litter the tunnel.  They have been cleared
away from the main road.  As the walls are illuminated you can see deep
scars in the earth where veins of ore have been mined.

76.1.-1.rawDesc:
A series of abandon rail carts litter the tunnel.  They have been cleared
away from the main road.  As the walls are illuminated you can see deep
scars in the earth where veins of ore have been mined.

77.1.-1.rawDesc:
You feel fresh air against your skin.  It is carried from a light sea
breeze blowing in from the eastern entrance of the Arkania Tunnel.  The last
bit of natural light ends and enchanted stones embedded into the tunnel wall
light up as you approach them and dim as you walk away.

78.1.-1.rawDesc:
The trail twist and turns through the foothills of the Gyphon mountain
range.  Along the eastern horizon you can see the ocean and the shoreline. 
The occassional flock of sheep that populate the foothills bah at you as you
pass.
